title: Scatty Bell - Black I Am / Version

lines.l: Oh yeah, yeah, not I am, not I leave, where I am, I'm still not free, oh, still I want
To fight our will
To help the black man
Clouds his dreams
Yeah
Hunger strikes me day and night
As I struggle, as I fight
Pain are so feroz, so bad
Just to make the black man glad
When I see my black folks living in shacks
Oh, I wonder what the black man lacks
Yeah, I've seen the rich man in the store
Looking down on its power
The rich man brought up on my head
Straight up a romantic dress
I beg and I plead for this to end
Yet no one seems to comprehend
Oh yeah, yeah, yeah
The rich man found up on my head
Strain up here, oh man, it's strange
I beg and I plead for this to end
Yet no one seems to comprehend
Black I am
Black I am, poor I am, and still not me
Still I won't fight our way
To help the black man climb this trail
Black I am, black I am
Yeah, whoa, whoa, whoa.
We'll be right back.
We'll be right back.
We'll be right back.
